title: This computer
statusServing: Serving this workspace to other devices
statusIdle: Not serving now: closing the window quits Leafen
keepRunningHelp: Hide Leafen instead of quitting it when you close its last window, so Command Search and serving go on.
openAtLoginHelp: While this computer serves its workspace to other devices, Leafen opens when you log in.
openAtLoginApproval: Allow Leafen in System Settings → General → Login Items.
openAtLoginApprovalWindows: Turn Leafen on in Windows Settings → Apps → Startup.
keepAwake: Keep this computer awake while it serves
keepAwakeHelp: The computer doesn’t fall asleep while it serves its workspace to other devices. The display still turns off.
awakeOnBatteryHelp: Off by default: on battery the computer sleeps as usual, just as the system’s own prevent-sleep setting applies only on power.
commandSearchHelp: A shortcut opens Leafen’s search even when the app is closed.
commandSearchShortcutHelp: Set the shortcut that opens Command Search.
menuBarIconHelp: An icon at the top right of the screen gets you to Leafen quickly.
shortcutModifierMac: The shortcut needs Option, Control or Command in it
shortcutModifierWindows: The shortcut needs Control or Alt in it
failed: Couldn’t change the setting. Try again.
finishSkipped: Finish what was skipped at install
